ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, point $C$ is on $\odot O$, extend $BC$ to point $D$ such that $DC=CB$, extend $DA$ to meet $\odot O$ at another point $E$, and connect $AC$, $CE$. If $\angle E = 32^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle D$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\because$ AB is the diameter of $\odot$O,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$ACB=$90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ CD=CB,\\
$\therefore$ AC is the perpendicular bisector of BD.\\
$\therefore$ AB=AD,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$B=$\angle$D,\\
$\because$ $\angle$B=$\angle$E,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$D=$\angle$E,\\
$\because$ $\angle$E=$32^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$D=$\boxed{32^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use coordinates/trigonometry. From the image, take the horizontal-looking line D-C-B as the x-axis with C between D and B, and take AC perpendicular to CB because AB is a diameter and C lies on the circle. From the text DC = CB, so set C=(0,0), B=(1,0), D=(-1,0), and let A=(0,t) with t>0. Then ∠D = ∠ADB is the angle that line DA makes with the positive x-axis, so tan(∠D)=t. The circle through A, B, C has equation x^2+y^2-x-ty=0. The line DAE has equation y=t(x+1). Intersecting this line with the circle gives the second point E with coordinates ((1-t^2)/(1+t^2), 2t/(1+t^2)). The slope of DA is t, while the slope of CE is 2t/(1-t^2), which is tan(2 arctan t). Thus the angle between EA/DA and EC is arctan t, the same as ∠D. Since the text gives ∠E=32°, conclude ∠D=32°.

图像描述：图中圆在右侧，圆心 O 在圆内；A、B 在圆上，线段 AB 经过 O，表示 AB 是直径。C 在圆的下方偏左处，D、C、B 在同一条近似水平直线上，且 C 位于 D 与 B 之间。D、A、E 在同一直线上，E 是直线 DA 与圆的另一个交点；图中还连接了 AC 和 CE。

推理：按指定坐标/三角方法，取直线 D-C-B 为 x 轴。因为 AB 是圆的直径且 C 在圆上，所以 ∠ACB = 90°，即 AC 垂直 CB。又 DC = CB，设 C=(0,0)，B=(1,0)，D=(-1,0)，A=(0,t)，其中 t>0。

此时 ∠D = ∠ADB，是直线 DA 与正 x 轴的夹角。直线 DA 的斜率为 t，所以 tan(∠D)=t。

过 A、B、C 的圆方程可设为 x^2+y^2+ux+vy=0。代入 B=(1,0) 得 u=-1；代入 A=(0,t) 得 v=-t。因此圆方程为 x^2+y^2-x-ty=0。

直线 DAE 过 D=(-1,0) 和 A=(0,t)，方程为 y=t(x+1)。将其代入圆方程，除去交点 A 后得到另一个交点 E 的坐标为 ((1-t^2)/(1+t^2), 2t/(1+t^2))。

所以 CE 的斜率为 [2t/(1+t^2)] / [(1-t^2)/(1+t^2)] = 2t/(1-t^2)。令 θ=arctan(t)，则 CE 的斜率为 tan(2θ)，而 DA 的斜率为 tan(θ)。因此直线 EA 与 EC 的夹角为 θ，也就是 ∠E=θ。另一方面 ∠D=θ。因此 ∠D=∠E。

已知 ∠E=32°，所以 ∠D=32°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, point $C$ is on $\odot O$, extend $BC$ to point $D$ such that $DC=CB$, extend $DA$ to meet $\odot O$ at another point $E$, and connect $AC$ and $CE$. If $\angle E = 32^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle D$ in degrees?
raw_record.answer: Given that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$. Since $CD = CB$, $AC$ is the perpendicular bisector of $BD$. Therefore $AB = AD$, so $\angle B = \angle D$. Also, $\angle B = \angle E$, hence $\angle D = \angle E$. Because $\angle E = 32^\circ$, $\angle D = 32^\circ$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, the center of the circle is labeled O; A, B, C, E are all on the circle, AB passes through the center O, shown as a diameter. D is on the left side of the circle, D, C, B are on the same straight line, and C is between D and B. D, A, E are on the same straight line, and AC and CE are also connected in the figure; the required ∠D is ∠ADB, and the given ∠E is ∠AEC. Reasoning: Because AB is a diameter of circle O, and C is on the circle, by Thales' theorem it can be obtained that ∠ACB = 90°. Also because D, C, B are collinear and DC = CB, C is the midpoint of BD; at the same time AC is perpendicular to CB, and therefore perpendicular to BD. Therefore AC is the perpendicular bisector of BD. Point A is on the perpendicular bisector of BD, so AB = AD, triangle ABD is an isosceles triangle, thus ∠ADB = ∠ABD. Since D, C, B are collinear, ∠ABD = ∠ABC. Also because ∠ABC and ∠AEC are both inscribed angles, and both subtend the same chord AC, ∠ABC = ∠AEC. It is known that ∠E = ∠AEC = 32°, therefore ∠D = ∠ADB = 32°.
